issue_context.title: GDAX brokerage only supports 3-character currencies
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
- GDAX brokerage should support all available symbols

#### Actual Behavior
- GDAX brokerage only supports 3-character currencies

#### Potential Solution
- Add new GDAX symbol mapper
- Update brokerage to use the symbol mapper

#### Reproducing the Problem
Code review:
- https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Brokerages/GDAX/GDAXBrokerage.Messaging.cs#L48
- https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Brokerages/GDAX/GDAXBrokerage.Messaging.cs#L405
- https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Brokerages/GDAX/GDAXBrokerage.Messaging.cs#L502

#### System Information
n/a

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
- [x] I have provided detailed steps to reproduce the issue

review_comments:
Don't think we should send in the market here since it's already sent in the constructor, it doesn't seem like a real argument.
Edit: ah I see now it's in the interface, maybe once we migrate all mappers to use this new system we could remove it as an argument
I find confusing that this method is named Get...Symbol but does return a ticker name and not a Symbol.
